title: PCPP system for an arbitrary property
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number and let $P$ be a property of Boolean strings of length $n$. The system has proof length $2^{2^n}$ and uses three queries. Its verifier chooses with equal probability between the property truth-table tester and the coordinate consistency tester.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a property on Boolean strings of length $n$
